memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Neurology, Dr S. Rao (consultant) for review of epilepsy management and consideration of possible medication optimization. Patient reports stable seizure control but wishes expert opinion on long-term therapy.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Neurology review completed. EEG shows no epileptiform activity. Recommendation: continue levetiracetam and lamotrigine at current doses; consider taper of lamotrigine only if seizure-free for >2 years. No changes advised now.
